The '''Exemplar's Mark''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|carbine weapon]] used by [[Exemplar (title)|Exemplar]] [[Zheus]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was his most trusted weapon and named after him for his bravery in battle. Many of the [[Outcasts (Kashyyyk)|Outcasts]] wielded such weapons in honor of Zheus.
